nuggets.text: Vernell Brown III is a Gators legacy: his father and grandfather both played football at Florida.
Vernell Brown III caught a 49-yard screen pass against FAU for the first touchdown of his college career.
The Gators scored on 10 of 11 drives against FAU in Jon Sumrall's debut as head coach.
The 66 points against FAU were the Gators' most in a season opener since 1994.
Aaron Philo followed offensive coordinator Buster Faulkner from Georgia Tech to Florida and won the starting quarterback job.
Jadan Baugh ran for 160 yards and three touchdowns against FAU, pushing past 2,000 career rushing yards.
Jon Sumrall was a Kentucky linebacker who led the Wildcats in tackles as a junior in 2004.
Steve Spurrier coined the nickname 'The Swamp' for the Gators' stadium in 1992.
The Mr. Two Bits cheer began in 1949 when Tampa insurance salesman George Edmondson started leading Gators fans.
Aaron Philo went 16-of-21 for 275 yards and three touchdowns in his Gators debut against FAU.
